messages:
Sam: FinLedger (Dedicated) reports invoice webhook parse failures after model upgrade. They see 'invalid JSON' from our API and downstream processors choke. Ticket INC-4527. P1.
Maya: Can you paste sample response + model + request payload? severity confirmed P1, SLA breach window.
Sam: Paste raw response:
```json
{\"invoices\":[{\"id\":\"inv_987\",\"total_cents\":12345,\"memo\":\"Payment received “Thank you”\"}]}

Thank you for choosing FinLedger.
```
Also request: POST /v1/generate body with {\"prompt\":..., \"json_mode\":\"strict\", \"max_tokens\":512, \"temperature\":0.0} Model: redwood-open-1. Last 20 minutes ~30% of responses had trailing text.
Liam: Two obvious problems: 1) trailing plaintext after the JSON blob (common on streaming/truncation), 2) sometimes model emits smart quotes and inconsistent escaping — but those escapes are usually valid JSON. The trailing text is the blocker for strict parsers. Can someone repro locally?
Aisha: Repro steps: call redwood-open-1 with the same prompt and stream=false, run 20 calls — I can reproduce 2/20 with trailing text. I'll create a minimal repro script and add to CI.
ops-bot: @ops deploy-alert: routing rule for FinLedger will be applied if ops approves.
Maya: Customer needs immediate workaround. Sam, send them this client-side snippet (Python) to extract JSON safely:
```python
import re, json
resp = client.generate(...)
match = re.search(r"\{.*\}", resp, flags=re.DOTALL)
if match:
    data = json.loads(match.group(0))
else:
    raise ValueError('no json found')
```
Sam: Sent workaround, but they want a server-side fix & SLA credit request.
Liam: Short-term server fix: enable a proxy flag "strict_postprocess" that strips trailing non-json after the last '}' and retries on parse failure with model 'redwood-compact-1' at lower max_tokens. I can push a hotfix to staging in ~30m. Will need eng-oncall approval to flip for the customer.
jen-eng: I'll own the proxy flag roll. Creating PR now, will target canary for FinLedger only.
dan-ml: Root cause hypothesis: our JSON-mode prompt template includes a trailing instruction like 'Also include a friendly note' which the model sometimes appends after the JSON while streaming. I'll remove that clause from the template and run evals, plus add negative examples to discourage trailing text.
Maya: Communication plan: reply to FinLedger with timeline, mention temporary workaround (client snippet), offer to apply routing rollback + SLA credit review. Draft message ready, will post after ops confirm.
Sam: Added owners: jen-eng for proxy hotfix, dan-ml for prompt change, Aisha for repro & CI test, Liam for rollback plan. ETA: PRs in 2 hours, canary flip in 3-4 hours, full rollback if needed.
Maya: Tagging @all — please react with :thumbsup: when you accept.
(thumbsup reactions from jen-eng, Liam, Aisha)
